 Print The Karnataka Private Postgraduate College's Association (KPPGCA) has released the Karnataka Management Aptitude Test (KMAT) 2026 on the official website, kmatindia.26.cbrt.co.in. Candidates scheduled to take the examination on November 14, 2026, can now access and download their hall tickets. Candidates must log in to the official portal using their candidate login ID and password to download the KMAT admit card PDF. The hall ticket is a mandatory document for entry into the examination centre. Candidates will not be permitted to carry a digital copy of the admit card on their mobile phones. Only a printed hard copy will be accepted at the examination centre. KMAT 2026 admit card: Steps to download hall tickets
 Candidates can follow the steps elucidated here to download the KMAT admit card 2026 on the official website: Visit the official website, kmatindia.com.
 Click on the KMAT 2026 admit card download link available on the homepage.
 Enter the candidate login ID and password in the designated fields.
 Submit the login credentials to access the admit card.
 The KMAT 2026 admit card will appear on the screen.
 Check the details mentioned on the hall ticket and download the PDF.
 Take a hard copy of the admit card for use on the examination day.
 KMAT 2026 admit card: Details mentioned
 After downloading the KMAT 2026 hall ticket, candidates must carefully verify the information printed on it. Any discrepancy in the details should be brought to the attention of the examination authorities before the examination. The admit card is expected to carry the following information: Candidate's name
 Roll number
 Name of the examination
 Examination centre name and address
 Candidate's photograph and signature
 Examination time
 Reporting time
 Examination-day instructions and guidelines
 Candidates should ensure that their photograph and signature are clearly visible and that the examination centre details are correctly mentioned. Alternatively, candidates can click on the link provided here to download the KMAT hall ticket 2026.
